description:
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
26000473
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F00413419
HSBC BANK USA, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION AS TRUSTEE FOR WELLS FARGO HOME EQUITY ASSETBACKED SECURITIES 2004-2 TRUST,
HOME EQUITY ASSET-BACKED
CERTIFICATES, SERIES 2004-2, is
the Plaintiff, and PATRICIA GAVICA,
ET ALS., are Defendants, writ of
execution for the sale of mortgaged
premises dated 02/23/2026.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 6TH DAY of MAY
A.D. 2026, at the hour of one thirty
o' clock by the then prevailing
(Standard or Daylight Saving) time,
in the afternoon of the said day, at
the Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston
Ave, New Brunswick, N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located
in the BOROUGH of SAYREVILLE in
the County of MIDDLESEX, and the
State of New Jersey.
Commonly known as: 34 Pinetree
Drive, Parlin (Sayreville Borough),
New Jersey 08859;
Tax Lot 15, Block 32.01 f/k/a Lot 15, Block 32.A
Dimensions of the Lot are (Approximately) .173 AC.
Nearest Cross Street: Elm Terrace.
The approximate upset sum is
$487,163.88 calculated through
February 25, 2026 plus any additional advance, interest, Sheriff's cost and commission to the date of
sale.
The occupancy status of the
subject property is unknown.
The sale is subject to unpaid taxes
and assessments, tax, water and
sewer liens and other municipal
assessments, The amount due can
be obtained from the local taxing
authority. Pursuant to NJSA 46:8B-21 the sale may also be subject to the limited lien priority of any
condominium/homeowner association liens which may exist. The sale may be further subject to Restrictions, reversions, reservations, and
easements of record.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale
and satisfaction of the mortgage
debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money,
the money will be deposited into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file a motion
pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and
extent of that person's claim and
asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money. The
Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the upset to be satisfied by said sale is the sum of THREE HUNDRED SIXTY
ONE THOUSAND FOUR HUNDRED SEVEN DOLLARS AND FOURTEEN CENTS ($361,407.14) dollars more
or less, plus interest together with the costs of this sale. THE UPSET AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO
FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS The subscriber reserves the right to adjourn said sale from time to time subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of such power as may be specially provided by law or rules of the
Court. Sold subject to conditions of sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of bid in certified check or official bank check at close of sale and the
balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
Attorney:
LOGS LEGAL GROUP LLP
14000 COMMERCE PARKWAY, SUITE B
MOUNT LAUREL, NJ 08054
Dated: 4/7, 4/14, 4/21, 4/28/2026
